# SCI-POINT Proposed Sanitized Author Inputs

Status: superseded by SHA-bound `r0.3` review candidate; not dispatchable

No implementation-blind Stage B task is authorized. ODQ-001 through ODQ-009
are closed. The repaired sanitized packet has been assembled and its exact bytes
are bound by [`AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md`](AUTHOR_PACKET_MANIFEST.md) and the
adjacent SHA-256 sidecar. The deterministic archive is described in
[`author_packet/README.md`](author_packet/README.md). Neither the manifest nor
the archive has been owner-approved for dispatch.

The realized `r0.3` packet contains the 37 purpose-built author objects listed
exclusively in the manifest. They include the repaired core, three distinct
unavailable method extracts, exact product/claim dependencies, applicability
facts, parent signal roles, boundary/envelope schemas, typed state and
diagnostic tables, uncertainty budget, draft policy records, falsifiable
prediction obligations, and semantic-change report.

The manifest is exclusive: any object not listed there is prohibited. Any
change to an admitted object requires a successor packet revision, recomputed
hashes, and renewed exact-byte review.

## Prohibited Inputs

- `INTERNAL_DOSSIER.md` and `PRIOR_WORK.md`;
- source code, implementation/configuration files, schemas, and defaults;
- audit findings, repairs, conformity records, tests, logs, and validation;
- reductions, Unity material, accepted-run evidence, performance, and current
  production behavior;
- historical current-code explanations or instructions to preserve a code
  structure; and
- unpublished owner discussion not captured in the exact approved decision
  artifact.

## Author Assignment

The future author must describe the approved compatibility-method family,
conditional generic contract, boundaries, and unavailable method-record
requirements completely and independently. It may clarify notation, expose a
contradiction, or present bounded options where explicitly delegated, but may
not invent the numerical compatibility, formal-error, or full-map-RMS method.
Dispatch requires explicit owner approval of the exact manifest and an
explicit fresh-task Stage B launch.
